static func snapshot(run: GameSession) -> Dictionary:

		quest_data[id] = Array(run.quests[id].completed_step_ids)
	for id: String in run.party_member_ids:
		var actor: ActorState = run.actors.get(id)
		if actor != null:
			actor_data.append({"instance_id": id, "definition_id": actor.definition_id, "health": actor.health})
	var facts: Dictionary = run.foraging.snapshot()
	return {
		"conversations": run.conversations.snapshot(),
		"inventory": facts.inventory, "collected_resource_ids": Array(facts.collected_resource_ids),
		"world_item_placements": facts.world_item_placements,
		"schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "content_version": CONTENT_VERSION,
		"location_id": run.current_location_id, "spawn_id": run.current_spawn_id,
		"player_instance_id": GameSession.PLAYER_INSTANCE_ID,
		"party_member_ids": Array(run.party_member_ids), "actors": actor_data,
		"elapsed_play_seconds": run.elapsed_play_seconds,
		"quests": quest_data, "completed_effect_ids": Array(run.completed_effect_ids),

for key: String in ["schema_version", "content_version"]:
		if not _integer(data.get(key), 1, 2147483647):
			result.errors.append("%s must be a positive integer" % key)
			return result
		var supported: int = SCHEMA_VERSION if key == "schema_version" else CONTENT_VERSION
		if int(data[key]) != supported:
			result.incompatible = true
			result.errors.append("unsupported %s %s; supported %d; files left unchanged" % [key, data[key], supported])
			return result
	var fields: Array[String] = [
		"schema_version", "content_version", "location_id", "spawn_id",
		"player_instance_id", "party_member_ids", "actors", "elapsed_play_seconds",
		"quests", "completed_effect_ids", "relationship", "progression",
		"environment", "light_source_overrides", "inventory",
		"collected_resource_ids", "world_item_placements", "conversations",
	]
	if not _exact_fields(data, fields):
		result.errors.append("schema v%d requires exactly: " % int(data.schema_version) + ", ".join(fields))
		return result
	result.errors = QuestService.validate_progress(data.quests, data.completed_effect_ids, catalog)

var restored: NpcSaveData.Result = NpcSaveData.restore(data.conversations, npc_catalog, float(seconds))
	result.errors = restored.errors
	if not result.errors.is_empty(): return result
	var candidate: GameSession = GameSession.new()
	result.errors = candidate.initialize(catalog, data.location_id, data.spawn_id, "prototype-hero", environment, npc_catalog)
	if result.errors.is_empty():
		for actor: Dictionary in data.actors:
			candidate.actors[actor.instance_id].health = int(actor.health)
		candidate.elapsed_play_seconds = float(seconds)
		for id: String in candidate.quests:
			candidate.quests[id].completed_step_ids = PackedStringArray(data.quests[id])
		candidate.completed_effect_ids = PackedStringArray(data.completed_effect_ids)
		candidate.relationship.trust = int(data.relationship.trust)
		candidate.relationship.reaction_ids = PackedStringArray(data.relationship.reaction_ids)
		candidate.progression.upgrade_ids = PackedStringArray(data.progression.upgrade_ids)
		result.errors = ForagingSaveData.restore(candidate, data.inventory, data.collected_resource_ids, data.world_item_placements, catalog)
		if not result.errors.is_empty(): return result
		candidate.conversations = restored.state
		result.session = candidate
	return result

class_name NpcDialogueRules
extends RefCounted
## Pure authored queries; linked target conditions are entry gates, as in source.
static func matches(conditions: NpcDialogueGraph.Conditions, memory: ConversationMemory, events: NpcEventMemory, seconds: float, threshold: int) -> bool:
	if conditions == null or memory == null or events == null or not NpcEventMemory.valid_time(seconds): return false
	if conditions.minimum_affinity >= 0 and memory.affinity < conditions.minimum_affinity: return false
	if conditions.maximum_affinity >= 0 and memory.affinity > conditions.maximum_affinity: return false
	if memory.level(threshold) < conditions.minimum_relationship_level: return false
	for id: String in conditions.required_flags:
		if id not in memory.flags: return false
	for id: String in conditions.excluded_flags:
		if id in memory.flags: return false
	for id: String in conditions.required_fact_ids:
		if id not in memory.learned_fact_ids: return false
	for id: String in conditions.unknown_fact_ids:
		if id in memory.learned_fact_ids: return false
	for id: String in conditions.required_seen_node_ids:
		if id not in memory.seen_node_ids: return false
	for id: String in conditions.unseen_node_ids:
		if id in memory.seen_node_ids: return false
	for condition: NpcDialogueGraph.EventCondition in conditions.events:
		if not events.matches(condition, seconds): return false
	return true

static func resolve(npc: NpcDefinition, memory: ConversationMemory, events: NpcEventMemory, seconds: float) -> NpcDialogueGraph.NodeDefinition:
	if npc == null or memory == null or memory.npc_id != npc.id: return null
	var selected: NpcDialogueGraph.NodeDefinition
	for id: String in npc.graph.entry_node_ids:
		var node: NpcDialogueGraph.NodeDefinition = npc.graph.nodes.get(id)
		if node == null or not node.availability.is_enabled() or not matches(node.conditions, memory, events, seconds, npc.level_one_affinity): continue
		if selected == null or node.priority > selected.priority or (node.priority == selected.priority and node.id < selected.id): selected = node
	return selected

static func choice_reason(npc: NpcDefinition, choice: NpcDialogueGraph.Choice, memory: ConversationMemory, events: NpcEventMemory, seconds: float) -> String:
	if not choice.availability.is_enabled(): return choice.availability.reason
	if not choice.gift_rule_id.is_empty(): return "Gifting capability is unavailable."
	if not choice.outcome_tag.is_empty(): return "Routine capability is unavailable."
	if memory.consumed(choice): return "Response already applied."
	if not matches(choice.conditions, memory, events, seconds, npc.level_one_affinity): return "Response conditions are not met."
	return ""

func _command_matches(npc_id: String, instance_id: String, node_id: String, token: String) -> bool:
	return not _executing and active() and _cursor_state == _session.conversations and _npc_id == npc_id and _instance_id == instance_id and _node_id == node_id and _token() == token

func _token() -> String:
	return "%d:%d" % [get_instance_id(), _generation]

func _clear() -> void:
	_prototype = null
	_selected_choice = ""
	_cursor_state = null
	_npc_id = ""
	_instance_id = ""
	_node_id = ""
	_generation += 1

func _toggle_journal() -> void:
	_cancel_item_drag()
	if not journal_open and not _combat_stable():
		return
	if backpack_open or dialogue.active() or get_tree().paused or world_host.transitioning or loading_save:
		return
	journal_open = not journal_open
	ui.show_journal(journal_open, _journal_text())
	ui.show_upgrade(progression)
	_update_controls()
	_refresh_interaction()

func _journal_text() -> String:
	return quests.journal() + "\n\n" + relationships.description()
